329e204.summary: Collects the units adjacent to a card on its side's board; a hero gets the first minion, others get neighbours and hero if leftmost.

329e238.summary: Returns the unit immediately to the right of the reference card on its side's board.

329e26c.summary: Picks a random card from the list of available attack targets for the attacker, or null if none.

328b614.summary: Builds a list of all units in play that are valid attack targets for the attacker.

329e314.summary: Returns how many free battlefield slots remain for the player or enemy side.

329e33c.summary: Computes the world position of a hero's card or anchor for the given side, converting board to screen to world coordinates.

329e368.summary: Computes the world position of a hero or one of its position reference points (e.g. anchors) for the given side.

329e560.summary: Compares the two heroes' obscured values and returns the warlord with the higher value, or null if tied.

329e6cc.summary: Finds the in-play unit of a side with the lowest current health that will not die from pending damage, defaulting to the hero.

32936e8.summary: Returns the player or enemy deck manager depending on the flag.

329c83c.summary: Returns the player's or enemy's shuffled deck list.

329e888.summary: Returns whether the player or enemy has already played a card this turn.

329e89c.summary: Returns whether the player or enemy has already played a troop this turn.

329497c.summary: Returns a deterministic pseudo-random int in a range from the match's predefined random number array, advancing its index.

3284a5c.summary: Returns true if the current match type is one of the networked match types.

32805c0.summary: Returns whether a match type is one that changes the player's ELO rating.

3296b9c.summary: Returns true if the current match is a tutorial or campaign match.

329e9b0.summary: Returns whether the match type is one of those played against the expected AI opponent, using a bitmask lookup.

329ea3c.summary: Returns true if the current match type is played against an AI opponent.

329eadc.summary: Returns true if the match (or replayed match) type is one where defence mode is not selected, e.g. practice or closed deck.

329efe4.summary: Builds the list of melee and ranged attack actions the acting card can perform against enemy units.

329fb64.summary: Sets the player's card currently being tracked by the mouse, stopping display of the previous tracked card.

329fe74.summary: Begins an attack or ability from a card, tracks it and highlights valid targets on the board.

32a01e8.summary: Queues an active ability action for a unit, unless it is no longer in play or blocked by another action.

32a0440.summary: Queues a use-waystone action for a unit if allowed; otherwise logs a warning and clears the waiting flag.
